user.title: Configure conversation agent
user.description: Choose models and edit their prompts and limits in the same block. {error}

data.name: Agent name
data.answer_error_reply: Reply when the action completed but answer generation failed

data_description.excluded_entities: Home Assistant exposed-entity settings are always respected. These entities are additionally excluded.
data_description.answer_error_reply: Used only after an action completed; it must not imply the action failed.
data_description.history_enabled: Use prior user inputs and final assistant replies in every model step.
data_description.history_messages: Rolling window for this Assist conversation. Includes only user/assistant text, with no added idle expiry.

data.query_target_keep_uncertain: Keep uncertain targets for state queries

data_description.url: Full native decisions endpoint, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions or http://SERVER:8321/v1/systemone.
data_description.api_key: Optional for local servers without authentication. This model uses only this key.
data_description.max_input_chars: Reject larger requests without truncating candidates or state data. This counts characters, not tokens.
data_description.test_connection: Sends a model-only test request. It never executes a Home Assistant action.
data_description.temperature_min: Uses your Home Assistant temperature unit; defaults assume Celsius. Device limits also apply.
data_description.temperature_step: Whole degrees by default. A device may require a larger step.
data_description.temperature_default_change: Interprets vague warmer/colder requests; execution still uses the rounding step.
data_description.service_prompt: Plain instructions; request and context are supplied separately. Clear this field to restore its default. No templating.
data_description.area_prompt: Plain instructions; request and context are supplied separately. Clear this field to restore its default. No templating.
data_description.target_prompt: Plain instructions; request and context are supplied separately. Clear this field to restore its default. No templating.
data_description.numeric_prompt: Plain instructions; request and context are supplied separately. Clear this field to restore its default. No templating.
data_description.numeric_mode_prompt: Plain instructions; request and context are supplied separately. Clear this field to restore its default. No templating.
data_description.text_prompt: Instructions for shopping or to-do item words. Sent once per extraction. Clear to restore the default. No templating.
data_description.text_confidence: Above this confidence, follow keep/drop. At or below it, use Keep uncertain item/message words.
data_description.message_prompt: Instructions for notification or announcement words. Sent once per extraction. Clear to restore the default. No templating.
data_description.target_filter_prompt: Instructions for selecting entities for state queries and actions that accept multiple targets. Sent once per selection. Clear to restore the default. No templating.
data_description.target_filter_confidence: Above this confidence, follow keep/drop. At or below it, use the corresponding Keep uncertain targets switch.
data_description.query_target_keep_uncertain: When confidence is at or below the corresponding threshold, keep the decision if enabled; drop it if disabled.
data_description.action_target_keep_uncertain: When confidence is at or below the corresponding threshold, keep the decision if enabled; drop it if disabled.
data_description.text_keep_uncertain: When confidence is at or below the corresponding threshold, keep the decision if enabled; drop it if disabled.
data_description.target_scope_prompt: Classify room-independent arealess entities; specific entities within one explicit or implied speaker area; explicit area(s) without specific entities; implied speaker area without specific entities; or unsure. Entity targets with an area are limited to one area. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.target_scope_confidence: Stop if the target type is unsure or below this confidence.
data_description.position_min: 0% is fully closed; 100% is fully open.
data_description.position_max: 0% is fully closed; 100% is fully open.
data_description.position_default_change: Used for vague requests such as open a little more or close a little further.
data_description.domain_prompt: Select one reporting domain after area selection for every state query. Clear to restore the default. No templating.
data_description.domain_confidence: Stop when domain selection is unsure or below this confidence. No fallback to all domains.
data_description.query_type_prompt: Choose yes/no or a detailed answer after area and domain selection. Clear to restore the default. No templating.
data_description.query_type_confidence: Stop if the answer type is unsure or below this confidence.
data_description.binary_answer_prompt: Answer yes/no from current candidate states, without entity keep/drop. Missing or ambiguous facts must return unsure. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.binary_answer_confidence: Stop if the yes/no answer is unsure or below this confidence. The answer model only translates a confirmed yes/no.
data_description.parameter_prompt: One Choice question for optional action fields plus none. Multiple parameters can be retained. Clear to restore the default. No templating.
data_description.parameter_probability_threshold: Keep each actual parameter strictly above this probability (default 0.3). Uses per-option probabilities, not overall confidence. none never overrides retained parameters.
data_description.action_area_prompt: One Choice question for explicitly requested areas. Multiple areas are allowed for area-only targets; specific entities with one explicit area use the unique highest probability. Implied areas use speaker context without this call. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.action_area_probability_threshold: Keep each area strictly above this probability for multiple-area selection (default 0.15). Single explicit areas use the highest probability instead. Overall confidence is not a filter.
data_description.action_entity_prompt: One Choice question for requested specific entities after domain and optional area filtering. Multiple targets are allowed. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.action_entity_probability_threshold: Keep each entity strictly above this probability (default 0.15), independently of overall confidence. none never overrides retained entities.
data_description.query_target_prompt: One Choice question with every candidate entity and none. Multiple targets can be retained. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.query_target_probability_threshold: Keep each entity strictly above this probability (default 0.02). Overall confidence and legacy keep/drop uncertainty settings do not apply. none never overrides retained real targets.

data_description.url: Full endpoint URL; no path is appended. Localhost refers to Home Assistant itself.
data_description.api_key: Optional for local servers without authentication. This model uses only this key.
data_description.max_input_chars: Reject larger requests without truncating candidates or state data. This counts characters, not tokens.
data_description.test_connection: Sends a model-only test request. It never executes a Home Assistant action.
data_description.prompt: Plain instructions; request and context are supplied separately. Clear this field to restore its default. No templating.

data_description.url: Full endpoint URL; no path is appended. Localhost refers to Home Assistant itself.
data_description.api_key: Optional for local servers without authentication. This model uses only this key.
data_description.max_input_chars: Reject larger requests without truncating candidates or state data. This counts characters, not tokens.
data_description.test_connection: Test the model connection and discover tools on enabled MCP servers. No tool is executed.
data_description.enable: When disabled, unrelated requests use the fixed unsure reply. No model request is sent.
data_description.prompt: Plain instructions; request and context are supplied separately. Clear this field to restore its default. No templating.
data_description.mcp_servers: HTTP servers only. Enable each server you want to use. Use your own proxy for stdio servers. Empty allowed-tool lists expose all advertised tools.
data_description.mcp_max_rounds: Maximum model rounds that may request tools for one user request.
